description: This file defines the NavigationItemBuilder class, which extends NavigationBuilder to facilitate building and configuring MenuItem objects for navigation purposes within OrchardCore. It includes methods for setting properties like caption, position, URL, permissions, and route values, and supports method chaining.

classes.name: NavigationItemBuilder
classes.description: A builder class for constructing and configuring MenuItem instances for navigation, supporting method chaining and route configuration.

methods.name: NavigationItemBuilder
methods.description: Default constructor initializing a new MenuItem.

methods.name: NavigationItemBuilder
methods.description: Constructor accepting an existing MenuItem to modify.
